about_pullquote: I start every job assuming I'd want this standard for my own family.
about_para_1: Notts Electrical Services Ltd was founded 18 years ago with a simple aim: to deliver honest, professional electrical work without the inflated prices. We're NICEIC approved, which means every installation and repair meets strict safety standards. Over two decades, we've built our reputation on turning up on time, diagnosing faults clearly, and quoting fairly.
about_para_2: Nottingham homeowners and businesses trust us because we listen first, explain what's needed, and never upsell. We've built a loyal client base through repeat work and word-of-mouth — the best compliment a trades business can receive. Whether it's a emergency call at 2am or a planned rewire, we bring the same professionalism.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Woke up to no power in half the house. Called Notts Electrical at 7am and they were here by 8:30. Turned out a loose connection in the consumer unit. Fixed in 20 minutes and charged a fair rate. Really impressed with the speed and professionalism.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had our entire bungalow rewired last summer. The crew were tidy, polite, and finished on schedule. They explained everything as they went and gave us all the certification we needed. Would use them again without hesitation.
reviews.author: Dorothy L.

reviews.text: Commercial job for our office. New data cabling and emergency lighting installed. They coordinated perfectly with our building manager, minimal disruption, and came in on budget. Proper professionals.
reviews.author: James P.
